## Context

F46, F49A, and F49B are approved. Distribution metadata omits the vendored alias wordlist license. Skill guidance implies that name is required although the maintained checker permits it. Package and MCP summaries omit plan review and signed completion verification.

## Plan

- Include the existing vendored license text in distribution license metadata.
- Verify wheel and source archive contents without changing the license or wordlist bytes.
- State that skill description is required and name is optional.
- Align only the pyproject.toml and server.json summaries with the approved GitHub About positioning.
- Preserve all other metadata.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Distribution license metadata includes LICENSE and docs/licenses/adjective-adjective-animal-LICENSE.txt.
- [x] Built wheel and source archive contain the vendored license.
- [x] The license and both wordlist resources remain byte-identical.
- [x] Skill guidance states that description is required and name is optional.
- [x] pyproject.toml and server.json use an aligned summary naming AI plan review and signed completion verification.
- [x] No GitHub About mutation or other metadata change occurs.
- [x] Focused package, skill, manifest, lint, type, and whitespace checks pass.
